normalized.quote: In just this half year alone, we’ve witnessed enormous growth in volume with over $1,875,000,000,000 in total volume and an average daily volume (ADV) of $10,965,000,000
normalized.why: A third party can check the exchange trading volume figures against financial records.

normalized.quote: Our all time high (ATH) was $53,068,090,693—the result of an extraordinarily active half-year.
normalized.why: The single-day all-time high exchange volume can be verified with market data.

normalized.quote: the total notional value of outstanding loans (in a 24 hour period) exceeded $2,500,000,000 in May!
normalized.why: The spot margin lending loan value can be checked against platform financial data.

normalized.quote: FTX has received >1 million user sign-ups within the last 6 months.
normalized.why: The user registration count can be verified using internal company database records.

normalized.quote: Our fundraising in February of 2020 valued FTX at $1B, representing an incredible milestone and making FTX the quickest company to reach unicorn status in history.
normalized.why: The valuation amount and date can be checked against venture capital funding announcements.

normalized.quote: Followers learned this July that FTX completed a Series B fundraising round that values our exchange at $18B.
normalized.why: The Series B valuation and fundraising amount can be checked against financial news reports.

normalized.quote: In the past six months, we welcomed 38 new employees globally to bring our total headcount to 110.
normalized.why: The employee headcount and hiring numbers can be verified against personnel records.

normalized.quote: Brett Harrison joined in May as FTX.us’s President to lead our US-regulated exchange.
normalized.why: The hire date and executive title can be verified through professional network filings or announcements.

normalized.quote: We donated $500,000 to OneMoreBreath Foundation to help with COVID relief efforts in India and $700,000 to Oxygen for India
normalized.why: The charitable donation amounts and recipient organizations can be checked against foundation records.

normalized.quote: Nevertheless, careful consideration on what we’ve done right this year allows us to identify the next steps towards becoming the best crypto company and brand in the world.
normalized.why: This is subjective puffery and cannot be objectively measured.

normalized.quote: We tirelessly strive towards delivering the best crypto and trading experience, bridging the gap between the crypto and TradFi worlds, and leading by example in innovation, customer service, and care for our communities.
normalized.why: This contains unverifiable superlative claims about the quality of the trading experience.

FTX global headcount reached 110 employees following the addition of 38 new staff members.
The FTX Foundation raised more than $10 million in charitable donations.
